text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our full-fledged journey 
through the Twinkle Series alongside 
Narita Taishin begins at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To showcase the razor-sharp burst of her 
late kick and wipe the smirks off those 
who had looked down on her—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Working hand in hand, they set off toward 
her debut race.
